projects.title: Your garden designs
projects.emptyHint: Create a new design, or import a .garden.json file.
projects.storageError: Your designs couldn't be loaded. This browser may be blocking local storage, for example in a private window.

errors.generic: Something went wrong and the change wasn’t made. Please try again.
errors.importNotJson: This file couldn’t be read as a garden design.
errors.importNotGardenFile: This file isn’t a Garden Designer design (.garden.json).
errors.importNewerVersion: This design was made with a newer version of the app. Reload the page to update the app, then try again.
errors.importInvalid: This design file is damaged or incomplete.

canvas.label: Garden plan
canvas.emptyHint: Start with the plot: import a site plan to trace over, draw the outline (P) or create a rectangle (R).
canvas.traceHint: Trace the plot over the site plan: press P and click its corners.

library.title: Plant library
library.comingSoon: The plant library arrives in milestone M5.

properties.title: Properties
properties.hint: Click an item on the plan to select it. Shift-click adds to the selection.
properties.label: Label

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.clearSelection: Clear selection / stop drawing or calibrating
shortcuts.shiftClick: Add to or remove from the selection

drawing.hintStart: Click on the plan to place the first corner.
drawing.hintNext: Click the next corner, or type a length (and angle) and press Enter.
drawing.hintFinish: Add more corners, or press Enter or click the first corner to finish.
drawing.keys: Angle: 0° = right, 90° = up. Backspace removes the last corner, Esc cancels, hold Alt to turn off snapping.
drawing.invalidLength: Enter a length greater than 0, e.g. 12,5.
drawing.invalidAngle: Enter an angle in degrees, e.g. 90.
drawing.needStart: Click on the plan first to place the starting corner.
drawing.needMoreCorners: A plot needs at least 3 corners.

plot.title: Plot boundary
plot.selfIntersecting: The outline crosses itself, so the area is not reliable. Move a corner to fix it.
plot.cornerHint: Drag a corner to move it. Click a corner to select it (Delete removes it). Drag or click the dot on an edge to add a corner.
plot.minCorners: A plot needs at least 3 corners.

rectangle.title: Rectangular plot
rectangle.invalid: Enter a width and depth greater than 0.
rectangle.note: You can move and add corners afterwards.
rectangle.replaces: Replaces the current plot outline (undo with Ctrl+Z).

calibration.hintStart: Calibrate the scale: click the start of a distance you know, such as a dimensioned edge on the site plan.
calibration.hintDistance: Type the real distance and press Enter.
calibration.keys: Zoom in to click precisely. Clicking again starts a new line; Backspace removes the last point, Esc cancels.
calibration.invalidDistance: Enter a distance greater than 0, e.g. 12,5.
calibration.needPoints: First click both ends of the distance on the plan.
calibration.tooShort: The two points are too close together. Zoom in and click them again.

sitePlan.title: Site plan
sitePlan.importHint: Trace your plot over a site plan, cadastral map or aerial photo (PDF, PNG or JPG).
sitePlan.pagesHint: {{file}} has {{count}} pages. Which one shows the site plan?

errors.unsupported: This type of file can’t be used. Choose a PDF, PNG, JPG or WebP file.
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large. Use a file of at most 100 MB, or save the page as an image first.
errors.unreadable: This file couldn’t be read. It may be damaged; try saving the page as a PNG or JPG.
errors.pdfPassword: This PDF is protected with a password. Save a copy without a password, or as an image.
errors.saveFailed: The image couldn’t be saved in the browser. The storage may be full.

sitePlan.notCalibrated: Not calibrated yet, so its size is a guess. Calibrate the scale before you trace.
sitePlan.alignHint: Drag the image to move it (arrow keys for small steps) and turn it with the round handle. A positive angle turns anticlockwise.
sitePlan.lockHint: So it can’t move by accident while you trace
